title: Draw a projection as a fan whose bands widen with the years ahead.
rule: Draw the median projection as a line in the subject ink with a dot and its value at each period, over two nested bands: the outer from past forecast errors in Stone step 1, and the inner, such as the range of every forecaster’s projection, in Stone step 2. Name the bands in a key, print the outer band’s ends at the last period, and name its probability in the measure line. A period with no date, such as the longer run, sits apart past a thin rule.
use_when: The reader asks where forecasters expect a measure to go and how wide the range of outcomes is.

use_instead.when: Survey margins around figures already measured
Directions under scenarios, with no numbers

text: A single projected line reads as a promise. The widening bands show how much less is known about later years, and drawing them from past errors grounds the range in the record rather than in opinion.
why.basis: Design judgment, from the chart system our founder and editor approved in November 2026

builders: Form fan-chart: node work/build/chart-kit/oa-chart.mjs build s59; encode x, y and the outer and inner bands; labels.apart sets a period apart, labels.key_outer, key_inner and key_median name the key.
